params.body:
Everything built on the workbench since main, on one branch, so main is the place to start.

What it adds:

- A relay for a council: enrolment on phones, changes of rights, one tap for a release of several changes, rules versions by their digest.
- An ask on record: who asked is one of us as the registry holds them, the asker's role counts, and only the one who asked gives the word.
- Mail through the gate: the gate's check before asking knows who asked.
- What an agent says back: an answer in words and the helpers it put to work, shown to the person who asked.
- What a person's screens read: what their agent remembers about them (keep and forget), the documents our agents read, and who is one of us.
- A second screen linked to a person: it reads and asks as them and approves nothing.
- Anchoring shown: `anchor watch` pins the record every round and tells the relay, which checks each receipt itself before keeping it.

None of the reading and answering is a submission: nothing is judged, written or approved by it.

Checked: `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass.

Known gaps, for whoever reads on:

- Rules L4 and L5 of our rule book (coding agents) cannot be decided yet: the gateway does not hand an agent's role and kind to the rule book.
- The gate has not been run sealed from this branch.
params.title: Handover: the relay for a council, asks on record, and what a person's screens read
